        break

            playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

# Compute and remove Spotify songs released before 2021 from: (1) song library, (2) all playlists in library

# Login once
spotify_password = None
for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if a['account_name'] == 'spotify':
        spotify_password = a['password']
        break

spotify_login = apis.spotify.login(username='ch-burch@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
spotify_token = spotify_login.get('access_token')
print('logged_in', bool(spotify_token))

# Fetch all playlists (ownership)
playlists_by_id = {}  # pid -> set(song_ids)
playlist_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    print('playlists_page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    for pl in resp:
        pid = pl['playlist_id']
        sids = pl.get('song_ids', [])
        playlists_by_id[pid] = set(sids)
        playlist_song_ids.update(sids)
    page_index += 1

print('total_playlists', len(playlists_by_id))

# Fetch all songs in song library
songs_in_library = {}  # sid -> song object
all_song_ids_in_library = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    print('songs_library_page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    for s in resp:
        sid = s['song_id']
        songs_in_library[sid] = s
        all_song_ids_in_library.add(sid)
    page_index += 1

print('total_song_library_songs', len(all_song_ids_in_library))

# Compute which songs are released before 2021
candidate_song_ids = sorted(list(all_song_ids_in_library | playlist_song_ids))
release_year = {}
missing_rd = 0
before_2021_ids = set()

for idx, sid in enumerate(candidate_song_ids):
    info = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    rd = info.get('release_date')
    if not rd:
        missing_rd += 1
        continue
    yr = int(rd[:4])
    release_year[sid] = yr
    if yr < 2021:
        before_2021_ids.add(sid)
    if idx < 5:
        print('sample_candidate', sid, info.get('title'), rd, 'yr', yr)

print('candidate_song_ids_count', len(candidate_song_ids))
print('missing_release_date_count', missing_rd)
print('before_2021_unique_song_ids', len(before_2021_ids))

# Targets
song_library_before_2021_ids = before_2021_ids & all_song_ids_in_library
print('song_library_before_2021_count', len(song_library_before_2021_ids))

playlist_remove_pairs_set = set()  # (pid, sid)
for pid, sids in playlists_by_id.items():
    for sid in sids:
        if sid in before_2021_ids:
            playlist_remove_pairs_set.add((pid, sid))

playlist_remove_pairs = sorted(list(playlist_remove_pairs_set))
print('playlist_remove_pairs_count', len(playlist_remove_pairs))

# Remove from song library
lib_success = 0
lib_fail = 0
lib_fail_details = []
for sid in sorted(song_library_before_2021_ids):
    resp = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_library(song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and resp.get('message'):
        msg = resp['message']
        if 'fail' in msg.lower():
            lib_fail += 1
            lib_fail_details.append((sid, msg))
        else:
            lib_success += 1
    else:
        lib_success += 1

print('library_removals_success', lib_success)
print('library_removals_fail', lib_fail)
if lib_fail_details:
    print('library_removals_fail_details_sample', lib_fail_details[:5])

# Remove from playlists
pl_success = 0
pl_fail = 0
pl_fail_details = []
for pid, sid in playlist_remove_pairs:
    resp = apis.spotify.remove_song_from_playlist(playlist_id=pid, song_id=sid, access_token=spotify_token)
    if isinstance(resp, dict) and resp.get('message'):
        msg = resp['message']
        if 'fail' in msg.lower():
            pl_fail += 1
            pl_fail_details.append((pid, sid, msg))
        else:
            pl_success += 1
    else:
        pl_success += 1

print('playlist_removals_success', pl_success)
print('playlist_removals_fail', pl_fail)
if pl_fail_details:
    print('playlist_removals_fail_details_sample', pl_fail_details[:5])

# Verification pass (read-only) - ensure no before-2021 songs remain in library or playlists
remaining_library_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for s in resp:
        remaining_library_song_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    page_index += 1

remaining_library_before_2021 = remaining_library_song_ids & before_2021_ids

remaining_playlist_song_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    for pl in resp:
        for sid in pl.get('song_ids', []):
            remaining_playlist_song_ids.add(sid)

# If any remain, print samples (IDs)
